name: Collection Map Interactions
description: Workflow for repository positioning, region management, and layout operations in CollectionMapPanel

scenarios.description: User drags and drops a repository to a new position

template.introduction:
**Repository Repositioned**

Moving repository **{{repository.name}}** to new position

events.collection_map.ui.repository_drag_starte: Started dragging **{{repository.name}}** (ID: {{repository.id}}) from region: {{drag.source_region}} in collection {{collection.id}}
events.collection_map.callback.position_updated: Position callback invoked for **{{repository.name}}** ({{repository.id}}) in collection {{collection.id}}: x={{position.x}}, y={{position.y}}, size={{position.width}}x{{position.height}}, region={{region.id}}
events.collection_map.state.optimistic_update_a: Optimistic update applied for {{repository.id}} in {{collection.id}} (type: {{update.type}}, memberships: {{memberships.count}}, timestamp: {{optimistic.timestamp}})
events.collection_map.ui.rendered: Map rendered for {{collection.id}} with {{repositories.count}} repos and {{regions.count}} regions (trigger: {{render.trigger}}, duration: {{render.duration_ms}}ms)
events.collection_map.github.sync_started: GitHub sync started for {{repository.id}} in {{collection.id}} (operation: {{sync.operation}}, timestamp: {{sync.timestamp}})
events.collection_map.service.repository_added: Re-adding {{repository.id}} to {{collection.id}} with layout: x={{metadata.layout.x}}, y={{metadata.layout.y}}, size={{metadata.layout.width}}x{{metadata.layout.height}}, region={{metadata.region_id}}
